<issue>
CorePropertiesPart.modified property returns created datetime instead of modified datetime

#### Description

The `modified` property of `CorePropertiesPart` is returning the created datetime instead of the modified datetime. This causes issues when trying to access the actual modification time of a presentation.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx.parts.coreprops import CorePropertiesPart
import datetime as dt

# Create a default core properties part
core_props = CorePropertiesPart.default(None)

# The modified property should return the modification time, not creation time
print("Created:", core_props.created)
print("Modified:", core_props.modified)

# These should be different values, but they return the same
assert core_props.created != core_props.modified  # This will fail
```

When working with existing presentations that have different created and modified timestamps, the `modified` property incorrectly returns the created timestamp instead of the actual modification time.
</issue>
